name: Vapi
description: Vapi voice-calling plugin. Lets OpenClaw agents initiate and receive phone calls via Vapi's voice AI platform.

apiKey.label: Vapi API Key
apiKey.help: Your Vapi private API key from dashboard.vapi.ai → Account → API Keys.

assistantId.label: Assistant ID
assistantId.help: Default Vapi assistant ID used when initiating outbound calls.

phoneNumberId.label: Phone Number ID
phoneNumberId.help: Vapi phone number ID to use as the caller for outbound calls.

agentId.label: Agent ID
agentId.help: OpenClaw agent ID to route inbound call events to (e.g. the ID of your Emma agent).

webhook.enabled.label: Enable Webhook Server
webhook.enabled.help: Start a local HTTP server so Vapi can deliver call events to this OpenClaw instance.

webhook.port.label: Webhook Port
webhook.port.help: Port the Vapi webhook server listens on (default: 3011). Set the matching Server URL in your Vapi assistant.

webhook.path.label: Webhook Path
webhook.path.help: HTTP path for the webhook endpoint (default: /vapi/webhook).

webhook.secret.label: Webhook Secret
webhook.secret.help: Optional bearer token Vapi sends in Authorization header for request verification.
